༄༅/ /them byang rin chen ljon shing bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /them byang rin chen ljon shing bzhugs so/ /

mkha' 'gro yang tig gi kha byang rin chen ljon shing zhes bya ba dpal don yod grub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zab cing rgya che'i mkhyen rab dpag bsam shing*/ /phan bde'i rang bzhin me tog 'bras mang ldan/ /thugs rje'i grib bsil shin tu rgya che bas/ /'gro blo'i gdung skyobs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa'i mkha' la bdud rtsi'i sprin 'khrigs pas/ /byams pa'i 'brug sgra snying rje'i glog phreng can/ /zhi bde'i chos char shin tu rmad byung bas/ /dge legs bsam 'phel mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpag med dus nas srid pa'i sems can la/ /zhi ba'i don ston thar pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bde gshegs rig 'dzin pad+ma thod phreng stsal/ /ye shes ma tsho rgyal zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bdag blo'i pad mtsho shin tu rgya che bar/ /mkha' 'gro snying thig 'od stong shar ba'i mthus/ /sngon med chos tshul bdud rtsis rab gang ste/ / snying po'i 'dab stong phyogs bcur rab tu rgyas/ /dpal ldan gangs ri'i tshal na dga' ba'i blo/ /shin tu rmad byung gtsug gi nor bu'i gdugs/ /srid las rnam grol lha yi dpag bsam shing*/ /yid mkha'i tshal du legs 'ongs bzang dgus brgyan/ /'dir ni skal ldan srid mtsho brgal 'dod rnams/ /nges don snying po'i chos tshul rin chen gru/ /tshe gcig thar gling bsgrod 'dir brten mdzod la/ /ji skad gsungs bzhin brtson pas gnas par rigs/ /gang gi byin rlabs ri bong 'dzin gzugs can/ /tshig don rnam bkra'i rgyu skar phreng ba 'di/ /bdag blo'i yid mkhar deng sang shar ba'i tshe/ /srid pa'i mtshan mo'i ma rig mun bsal nas/ /ye shes snang bas bde chen thob bya'i phyir/ /zab mo'i gnad bsdus snying po'i bcud phyung nas/ /skal bzang blo yi kun+da rgyas bya'i phyir/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsal bar rab phye nas/ /dum dang ma bus dkar chag chig dril te/ /lus su grub pa'i rang bzhin brtsams pa ni/ / dbang gi sdong po khrid kyis yal gas brjid/

/rgyab chos 'dab ma me tog 'bras mang ldan/ /rin chen ljon shing bzang por grub pa 'di/ /skal ldan skye bo'i bya tshogs dga' bar mdzod/ /gsang sngags dbang gi chu bo rgya mtsho yis/ /rang gzhan rgyud rnams legs par sbyangs pa 'di/ /tha ba sra ba rlan gyis dngas pa bzhin/ /dbang gis sbyang phyir ma bu'i grangs bstan pa/ /dbang gi sngon 'gro gter 'byung lo rgyus dang*/ /dam tshig skong dang mkha' 'gro'i brda dbang dang*/ /dbang bzhi'i rim pa byin rlabs bla ma'i dbang*/ /rig pa'i rtsal dbang mkha' 'gro'i don dbang dang*/ /gzhan bka' gtad rgya bka' bsrung bkar bsgo ste/ /ma dgu bu bzhis rin chen dbang phreng 'grub// de dag rnams ni zab cing rgya che bas/ /rin chen dkar shog ngos la legs par mnan/ /smin cing grol bar byed pa'i gdams pa ste/ /de yi lag len ma bu'i grangs bstan pa/ /bla ma'i gsol 'debs dri med zla rgyas dang*/ / bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun khrid yig nor bu lugs/ /nyi zla gza' skar zab mo rab 'byed dang*/ /rin chen gser phreng ma bu rnam pa drug /yang zab gnad de rab tu dkon pas na/ /rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la legs par bkod/ /de dag rnams kyi rgyab chos bstan pa ni/ khregs chod thod rgal zab don sna tshogs gsum/ /so so phye nas go rim nges pa'i don/ /dum dang ma bu'i grangs ni 'di dag go khregs chod rgyab yig nam mkha' skor gsum la/ / nam mkha' rab 'byams lta ba bya rtsol med/ /nam mkha' klong yangs sgom pa blo las 'das/ /nam mkha' dri med spyod pa blang dor med/ /gdod ma'i ngang du gnyis med la zla 'o/ /thod rgal rgyab yig 'od gsal skor gsum la/ man ngag rin chen gser gyi sgrom bu yis/ /zab mo'i gnad rnams mdor bsdus gcig tu dril/ /tshig don rin chen bang mdzod bzang po yis/ /de dag don rnams so sor phye ste bshad/ /zab don rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi snying po yis/

/shin tu rgya che'i rnam grangs dpag med bkod/ /gnyis ka'i don bsdu bogs 'byin chig dril ba/ /gsang spyod rdo rje lam bstan snying por bstan/ /de dag rnams ni rin chen shog skyar bkod/ /zab don sna tshogs gab pa'i bcud phyung ba/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs pa snying gi snying po ni/ /gang dang mi 'dra bstan par phangs na yang*/ /phyi rabs skal ldan brtse ba'i sems bzung ste/ /snying phyug lag mthil dag tu bkod pa 'di/ /shin tu zab pa'i yang zab shog ser can/ /snying dang 'dra bas ma spel sems la spos/ /de yi dum dang ma bus grangs bstan pa/ /rig 'dzin mchog sgrub tshe gcig rig 'dzin 'grub/ /yang gsang mkha' 'gro bde chen rgya mtsho la/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ye shes 'khor lo dang*/ /rlung drug rdo rje'i chings te gsum gyis tshad/ /de yis dngos grub gang 'dod lhun gyis grub/ /rlung sbyor ye shes dra bas de nyid mthong*/ /zab lam bde chen rgya mtshos ting 'dzin 'grub/ /'od gsal 'khor los tshe 'dir 'od lus 'grub/ /gzhi snang ngo sprod grol bzhi'i snang ba shes/ /'od gsal sbubs 'jug mtshan mo'i 'od gsal 'grub/ /sgron ma bzhi skor ye shes rang gnas shes/ /de ltar ma bu rnam grangs rnam dgu yang*/ /chos sde'i rang bzhin rnam bdun dag tu bsdus/ /de dag rnams ni yang zab bla na med/ /mkha' 'gro'i zhal gdams shog ser ngos la bkod/ /rigs lnga'i gsang sgrub pad+ma stong ldan la/ /phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang rnam bzhis tshang*/ /de yis gtso bor rang bzhin sprul sku thob/ /rigs lnga'i bcud len bdud rtsi thigs pa la/ /sa yi bcud len bdud rtsi yang zhun dang*/ /chu yi bcud len bde chen rgya mtsho dang*/ /me yi bcud len bde drod rang 'bar dang*/ /rlung gi bcud len dpag bsam ljon shing dang*/ /nam mkha'i bcud len ye shes gsang skor te/

/mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du 'grub/ /gegs sel nad 'don bdud rtsi sprin phung la/ /'khor lo lnga ste phyi nang bar chad sel/ /'chi ba brtag bslu nyi zla gza' bral la/ /dum bu gnyis te rnal 'byor don chen 'grub/ /btags grol man ngag rin chen snying po yis/ /de nyid don shes rang gzhan phan pa 'grub/ /'di dag rin chen shog 'dra'i ngos la bkod/ / sreg sbyong cho ga 'od kyi snye ma yis/ /tshe 'das sku gdung ji ltar bzhu ba bstan/ /gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo bzang po yis/ /bar do'i 'gro ba rnams la phan btags bshad/ /mchod rten rab gnas rin chen drwa ba yis/ /tshwa tsha'i sgo nas tshogs bsags sgrib sbyong bstan/ /rab gnas cho ga ye shes dri med kyis/ /sku gsung thugs rten rab tu gnas par bshad/ / mthong snang rin chen gser gyi drwa ba yis/ /nyams su blangs pa'i rtags tshad 'bras bu bstan/ /'di dag rnams kyang zab cing rgya che bas/ /rin chen dkar shog bzang po'i ngos la mnan/ /de ltar zab chos bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir/ /bka' srung sgrub sde rgya mtsho'i snying po las/ /shin tu yang zab rin chen rnam gsum las/ /g.yu sgron sgrub thabs zla ba 'dod 'jo yis/ /ci bsam 'grub cing rkyen ngan bar chad sel/ /yid bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal po 'dra/ /gza' bdud gsang sgrub dug gi spu gri yis/ /gnod byed srog rtsa skad cig gcod pas na/ /'jigs pa'i gnam lcags 'khor lo bskor ba 'dra/ /srog sgrub gsang sgrub dug mda' nag po yis/ /dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlog pas na/ /'jigs pa'i ser sprin me ltar 'bar ba 'dra/ / 'di dag mkha' 'gro snying tig rnal 'byor pa'i/ /nyams len gsar ba'i rgyab brten yang gsang du/ /ji ltar gsungs bzhin bdag gis shog 'drar bkod/ /zab mo'i gnad bsdus bdag gis tshad phab pas/ /shin tu gsang ste snying gi tshul du bcangs/ /phyi rabs dad brtson snying gi bu gcig la/

/ lhag chad med par byin nas bka' rgyas thob/ /des kyang bstan pa'i btsas su byed par shog /de ltar gsang ba'i man ngag snying po'i grangs/ /don rnams bsdus te gcig tu dril ba ni/ /dbang gi ma bu'i skor la ma bcu gsum/ /khrid kyi skor la ma bu rnam pa drugasidhi /rgyab chos skor la ma bu lnga bcu gcig /de ltar dril bas bdun cu tham pa ni/ (< a > rgyab chos skor la ma bu sum cu brgyad/ /de ltar dril bas lnga bcu rtsa bdun ni/ ) cha shas dbye bas rgya cher bkod pa yin/ /sde tshan dbye bas grangs su mdor bsdu na/ /rin chen shog skya shog ser shog 'dra gsum/ /shog skya'i sde tshan la ni bcu bzhi dang*/ /shog ser bco lnga rin chen shog 'dra la/ /sde tshan bcu bzhis legs par gtan la phab/ /sde tshan dbye na bzhi bcu rtsa gsum gyis/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i snying po tshang*/ /de las mang nyung byung na gdams pa 'chal/ /de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces/ /e ma ho/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal sras pad+ma yis/ /phyogs bzhir zab gter sbas pa'i rim pa la/ / lho ru bskyed rdzogs dril ba sdong po'i skor/ /nub tu gsal ba me tog kha bye 'dra/ /byang du rgyas pa yal 'dab chen po la/ /shar du legs smin 'bras bu bcud du 'dril/ /de yi nang nas yang zab 'bras bu'i skor/ /rdo rje snying po'i theg pa mthar thug 'di/ /kun gyi yang rtse yang rab 'ga' yi phul/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gsang ba'i mdzod du sbas/ /deng sang tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral la/ /zab mo'i dgongs gter mi yul snang ba ni/ /chu mo glang la shog ser sgo phye nas/ /rjod byed tshig la dbang ba'i cha tsam las/ /zab mo'i de nyid rtogs pa'i mthu med do/ /deng sang shing yos dpyid zla gsum dag la/ /bla ma mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs lung bstan las/ /brjod bya'i don rnams bdag gi snying la babs/ /mngon sum nyid du mkha' 'gros gnad bstan nas/

/tshig don ma lus rtogs pa'i nyi shar bas/ /bdag blo'i pad kha rab tu rgyas par byas/ /de don man ngag yang zab snying po'i don/ /ji ltar rtogs bzhin 'khrul pa med pa'i blos/ /gab cing gcus te sbas pa'i gnad rnams kun/ / phyi rabs don du ma sbas gsal bar bkod/ /don 'dir bdag blo 'khrul pa med pas na/ /rig 'dzin gong ma'i man ngag rnams dang 'dra/ /the tshom mi dgos nor ba'i dri ma med/ /phyi rabs skal ldan rab tu dga' bar mdzod/ / zab mo'i gnad rnams 'dir bkod dge ba des/ /'gro kun theg mchog rin chen 'dir zhugs te/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'od lus 'dir 'grub nas/ / srid pa'i zhing 'dir 'gro ba'i don byed shog /ma lus bde gshegs snying po 'gro ba kun/ /med snang 'khrul pa'i 'khor ba las brgal te/ /thams cad phyam gcig gdod ma'i sar phyin nas/ /sku lnga ye shes 'du 'bral med par shog /mkha' 'gro snying tig lha yi dpag bsam shing*/ /bdag blo'i skyed tshal rwa bar legs 'khrungs pas/ /de don man ngag me tog 'bras mang des/ / 'gro kun bya tshogs rab tu dga' bar shog /chos tshul 'di ni dri med 'od zer gyis/ /ston gsum me tog 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas su bkod/ /snying tig rgyud don man ngag rgya mtsho las/ /zab don rin chen snying po 'di blangs te/ /tshig don sna tshogs 'dod dgu'i char phab pas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par shog /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi them byang rin chen ljon shing zhes bya ba/ dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyi 'od zer gyis blo'i pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis/ /rang gi rtogs pa'i don ji lta ba bzhin phyi rabs kyi skye bo dpag tu med pas rtogs par bya ba'i phyir skal bzang gi slob ma 'od zer go chas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/

ston gsum me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /dge legs su gyur cig /'di nyid phyi rabs kyi tshe skal bzang gi rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis dbang khrid gdams pa dang bcas pa rim pas btab nas/ snod legs par brtags te rang gzhan gyi don grub ngo shes pa'i slaub ma gcig la them byang gtad pas 'gro don 'grub cing phan thogs pas de ltar bya'o/ /gzhan dag la them byang rab tu sba zhing gsang bar bya'o/ /gza' bdud chen po rā hu la dang*/ bshan pa srog sgrub nag mo dang*/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gsum la bka' 'di gtad pa yin pas thub par sru ngas shig /las med kyi lag tu 'grim du ma 'jug cig /las can gyi lag tu sprod cig /'dra min dang bcos bslad byed pa byung na snying khrag gting nas drongs shig /sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ kha thaṃ dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)them byang rin chen ljon shing*/ -PAGE 316--PAGE 317--PAGE 310-
